$comment: P69 (lane cs): `weak` written on a PROTOTYPE reaches the DEFINITION of the same unit, in both attribute positions, END TO END — three units, one image. `defaults.c` declares `lead` (attribute before the specifiers) and `trail` (attribute after the declarator) weak and then defines each with nothing written; `overrides.c` defines both strongly; `main.c` adds them. A weak definition yields, so the image returns 120 + 80 = 200. If either prototype's `weak` does not reach its definition the program does not link at all (two strong definitions of one name across units), so the exit code is the assertion and it cannot be met by a dropped attribute.
